title: How to Build an Instagram and Facebook Auto Reply Bot for DMs and Comments in 2026
author: Sardar Awais
excerpt: Learn how to build and deploy an official Instagram and Facebook auto reply bot for DMs, Messenger, and comments that safely captures leads, answers FAQs, and drives sales 24/7.
content:
For brands, creators, and e-commerce stores, Instagram DMs and Facebook Messenger are the highest-converting sales channels. However, replying manually to hundreds of direct messages and post comments across both platforms like *"Price?"*, *"Link please!"*, and *"How do I order?"* is physically impossible without a 24/7 support team.

That's where a custom **Instagram and Facebook auto reply bot** comes in.

## Why Unofficial Bots Get Banned (And How to Stay 100% Safe)

Many businesses make the fatal mistake of using browser automation scripts (like Selenium or Puppeteer) or unauthorized third-party apps that ask for your login passwords. Meta's anti-bot algorithms detect automated browser sessions within hours, resulting in shadowbans or permanent account restrictions.

The only reliable, enterprise-grade way to automate both Instagram and Facebook is through the **official Meta Graph API** (Instagram Messaging API and Facebook Messenger Webhooks for Business Accounts).

### Core Capabilities of a Unified Meta Automation Bot

1. **Comment-to-DM Trigger (Instagram Reels & Facebook Posts):** When a user comments *"Discount"* or *"Price"* on your latest post or ad, the bot immediately sends a personalized DM with their unique coupon code and direct checkout link.
2. **Unified 24/7 Instant FAQ Resolution:** Automatically answers inquiries regarding shipping times, store locations, sizing guides, and return policies across both Instagram DMs and Facebook Messenger.
3. **New Follower & Lead Welcome Workflows:** Sends an automated, friendly greeting to new followers or first-time message senders, introducing your portfolio or top-selling products without coming across as spam.
4. **Seamless Human Handoff:** When a lead indicates high intent or requests custom consultation, the bot flags the conversation and alerts your team via Telegram or Slack.

## Technical Architecture

We build custom social media automation systems using **Python (FastAPI)**, **Node.js**, or **ManyChat webhook integrations**. The architecture listens to real-time Webhook events sent by Meta's graph servers, processes the intent using lightweight NLP or OpenAI models, and fires the appropriate response back via the Graph API within 1–2 seconds.

## Turn Followers into Paying Clients

If your business is active across social media, automated response times mean the difference between closing a sale and losing a customer to a competitor.
